simplified: Antennae: the combed 2x plumes become 1 px plaster arcs without comb teeth (plaster 5 on the lit one), the far one a short plaster_cool stroke in E/W.
Eyes: the big round 2x eyes become 2 x 2 ink with a 1 px snow glint; brow and cheek tufts are dropped; the muzzle is a lit 2 px step.
Ruff: the downward fur strokes become three snow tones with a scalloped hem (snow_cool pairs); the chin shadow stays.

Coat: the fold bands become 2 px dusk bands (lit left, deep right) either side of the dark front seam (S); the chevron margin and the faint eye-spot on the tails are dropped, the swallowtail tips stay as dusk_warm texels.
Lamp: shutter slats become an iron box with a brass cap, handle and foot and a single lamp-glow texel (S, E); in W it sits behind the coat with no glow.
notes: Same design as the 2x final (option C): a pale moth head with two swept antennae and big eyes, a wide snow ruff, a narrow dusk swallowtail coat with a brass belt, the shuttered lamp at her right hip (screen left in S, in front in E, behind in W), iron feet.
W is drawn, not mirrored: the light stays at the upper left, and the lamp moves to the far side instead of reflecting.
Compared with Matt's 1x Bramble: three tones a material plus the edge tone, solid ink eyes, chunky clusters.
